description: Keep Pages Functions OFF static files. Before this file, _middleware.ts ran on EVERY request — ~30 function invocations per page view just for hashed chunks/fonts/icons — which blew through the 100k/day free Functions quota (101,774 on 2026-08-21) and risked /api/* dying for the rest of each day. Static paths listed here are served by the asset layer with zero invocations; every real route (api, hubs, song/album/artist/playlist SEO, sitemaps, apk, img) stays on Functions.
